items.name: Wind crystals
items.lore: The sky's own coin. Kept in your purse, never in a bag slot.

items.name: Moonwheat
items.lore: Silver ears that open at moonrise.

items.name: Moonwheat seeds
items.lore: Sow them where the wind turns the windmills.

items.name: Sunberry
items.lore: Warm to the touch, even after sunset.

items.name: Cloudcotton
items.lore: Spun by the plant from passing clouds. It never quite stops drifting.

items.name: Glowcap
items.lore: A mushroom that keeps a lantern's light for whoever picks it.

items.name: Sky apple
items.lore: Ripens in the crowns of the tallest trees, where only fliers reach.

items.name: Ashwind log
items.lore: Pale, light wood that hums faintly in a breeze.

items.name: Moonbark log
items.lore: From the Elder Canopy. Its rings glow like ripples on a moonlit pond.

items.name: Quartzlight
items.lore: Clear crystal that rings when the wind passes over it.

items.name: Frostglass
items.lore: Ice that forgot how to melt.

items.name: Sunstone
items.lore: Found in geodes of the Hollow Deeps, warm as a sunrise held in the hand.

items.name: Star minnow
items.lore: Schools of them swim through the cloud sea at night, like a second sky.

items.name: Drift feather
items.lore: Shed by sky whales' companions and carried for leagues on the wind.

items.name: Wind essence
items.lore: What is left when Murk lets go of the wind it stole.

items.name: Petal rune I
items.lore: A glyph stone that leaves a few petals in your wake.

items.name: Petal rune II
items.lore: Three runes fused into one. The petals fall thicker now.

items.name: Swift tempering stone
items.lore: The Smith tempers gear with it for a quicker hand.

items.name: Meadow tea
items.lore: Sweet and grassy. Farmers swear the crops grow fuller after a cup.

items.name: Meadow stool
items.lore: Three legs, a woven seat, and a view of the clouds.

items.name: Wooden sickle
items.lore: Cuts a 2 m swathe through ripe crops as you fly low.

items.name: Ashwind axe
items.lore: Fells a tree in a few clean chops; the tree folds back into a sapling.

items.name: Quartz pick
items.lore: Tuned to the pitch of common veins.

items.name: Driftwood rod
items.lore: Casts a line of light into water or cloud.

items.name: Wing blades
items.lore: Twin blades of wind-steel with gold guards. They appear in your hands only to strike.

items.name: Wayfarer mantle
items.lore: A traveller's cloak, stitched with a little extra Light.
